tests.content:
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { average } from '../src/avg.mjs'
test('average computes mean', () => { assert.equal(average([2, 4]), 3) })
test('average empty array', () => { assert.equal(average([]), 0) })
tests.notes: Two tests: (1) mean of [2, 4] is 3, (2) mean of empty array is 0. Run via node --test test/avg.test.mjs. Node v24.19.0 available.
